The Wishing Tree

★★★★★ ★★★★★ (2 reviews)
SKU: WISHING
by Christopher Isherwood
  • 229 pages, US paperback
  • 0-06-250402-9
$9.95 $1.00
  • DescriptionDetails
  • Reviews

Gifted novelist and playwright Christopher Isherwood examines the whole question of religion in this collection of short articles that explore Vedanta philosophy in a personal way. He explains an Indian philosophy that sees God at the heart of everything, good and bad.

The book is written for the person who wants to be honest with himself or herself and demands that religion be rational, sensible yet feel right to the soul.

What is the role of religion?
Can religion be rational and sensible for those of us who can't manufacture "faith?"

Read how we can use our intelligence fully in the quest for meaning, yet expand our heart to new heights of creativity and love.

Price reduced since paper is starting to yellow.

The Wishing Tree

I was deeply moved by Christopher Isherwood's life journey. I bought this book because his version of English translation of Bhagavad Gita is, in my opinion, the most beautiful one. I read Gita every morning and understanding the mind of the translator deepens my appreciation and gratitude for what he has done.
